raw_text:
Root app: Next.js (TypeScript) in `src` with App Router. UI `src/components`; hooks `src/hooks`; utilities `src/lib`; routes `src/app`; API `src/app/api/*`; assets `public/`; scripts `scripts/`; Vite app `vite-base-template/`.
`npm run dev` — start Next.js with Turbopack on `http://localhost:3000`.
`npm run build` — production build.
`npm run start` — run built app.
`npm run lint` — ESLint checks.
`cd vite-base-template && npm run dev` — start Vite (default `:5173`).
`npm --prefix vite-base-template run build` — build Vite app.
TypeScript strict, `noEmit: true`; `@/*` → `src/*`. ESLint config `eslint.config.mjs`; `<REDACTED_USER>/no-explicit-any` is disabled. 2-space indentation; PascalCase components, camelCase variables/functions, kebab-case files. Tailwind CSS v4.
No test runner is currently configured. Prefer:
Unit/UI: Vitest or Jest + React Testing Library.
Place tests next to source: `Component.test.tsx` or under `__tests__/`.
Aim for critical-path coverage (core components, API handlers).
Commits imperative, concise, scoped. PRs must include summary/rationale, local test steps/screenshots for UI, linked issues, and build/lint/run checklist. Use `.env.local`; do not commit secrets. `NEXT_PUBLIC_*` are client-exposed. Rotate leaked credentials promptly; prefer per-env keys. Rewrites `/iframe/*` to `src/app/api/iframe`.
